text:
ashley: heads up — onboarding sampleapp is spamming INFO logs with full request IDs after the otel hook init change

mike: seeing that too. repro steps?

ashley: clone sampleapp, set REDWOOD_ENV=staging, run `npm run start:devex-sample` then hit /generate a few times. logs show the whole req-id (user token suffix) exposed.

samir: @ashley can you paste a redacted snippet? curious if it's only at INFO level or also DEBUG.

ashley: paste below (redacted manually):
```
INFO 2026-03-21T18:12:01Z request received req_id=clz_1234567890abcdef user=alice@example.com prompt_len=42
DEBUG 2026-03-21T18:12:01Z otel-hook: start trace TRACE_ID=312a... span=init
INFO 2026-03-21T18:12:01Z routing to runtime model=redwood-small req_id=clz_1234567890abcdef
```

zara: yikes, looks like the masking/redaction that used to run in the logging middleware isn't firing when the OTEL auto-instrumentation is enabled.

mike: I think the hook order changed in the new SDK: we now init otel before express middlewares, so request-id header is attached later. Redaction middleware expects `req.id` to exist earlier.

samir: confirmed locally — when OTEL_AUTO=true the express-reqid middleware runs but doesn't see the canonical id; otel sets its own trace id in headers and our redact step only matches `req.headers['x-request-id']` if present.

ashley: reproduce commands if helpful:
```
# without otel
OTEL_AUTO=false npm run start:devex-sample && curl -H "x-request-id: clz_XXX" localhost:3000/generate
# with otel
OTEL_AUTO=true npm run start:devex-sample && curl -H "x-request-id: clz_XXX" localhost:3000/generate
```

zara: workaround for now: change order in sampleapp to mount our reqid middleware before otel instrumentation, or add a fallback redactor that scrubs any token-like strings in logs (regex). Not ideal.

mike: can we make the SDK's otel init idempotent and expose hook points so apps don't have to reorder? maybe an option like `redwood.telemetry.hookOrder=\"motorway\"` jk but seriously: config to preserve middleware order or to call our redaction after otel init.

samir: opened an issue: https://github.com/redwood-inference/sdk/issues/432 (WIP) — summary: OTEL init race causes request-id leakage at INFO logs for a subset of requests; proposal: 1) emit minimal logs in SDK before app-level redaction, 2) provide a `redact` callback hook, 3) update sampleapp to recommend mounting redaction after instrumentation in README.

ashley: for immediate fix in prod onboarding images, we should add a post-start scrubber that replaces anything matching `clz_[0-9a-f]{8,}` with `clz_<redacted>` in stdout. Ugly but quick.

infra-bot: deploy check: staging images built at 2026-03-21T16:00Z include OTEL_AUTO=true by default. Flagging rollout hold.

devex-bot: FYI @devex channel: created a short troubleshooting doc: https://go/redev/telemetry-reqid-ordering (draft) + checklist for sampleapp onboarding.

mike: agree on checklist: add unit tests for logging redaction order, add e2e with OTEL_AUTO toggled, and ship patch to sampleapp in next minor.

zara: adding a note for docs: "If you use OTEL auto-instrumentation, ensure redaction middleware runs after instrumentation or enable SDK option `redwood.telemetry.postRedact=true` once available."

ashley: thanks all. I'll add the stdout scrubber to onboarding image and link the issue in the onboarding ticket. :thumbsup:

samir: ping me when you have the PR, i'll review the regex so we don't accidentally drop valid ids in tests.

mike: leaving this thread open — follow-up in #devex tomorrow to decide the SDK change.

ashley: closing loop for today. good catch everyone. :party_parrot:
